question: Who Owns Sweetgreen?
quick_answer: Sweetgreen is an independent, publicly traded company listed on the New York Stock Exchange under the ticker SG, so it is owned by its shareholders. It was founded in 2007 by three Georgetown University friends, Nicolas Jammet, Jonathan Neman and Nathaniel Ru, and went public in 2021.

body.heading: Who owns Sweetgreen?
body.text: Sweetgreen is a public company, owned collectively by its shareholders. It trades on the New York Stock Exchange under the ticker SG. The founders remain closely associated with the company and its leadership, but as a public company it is owned by its shareholders rather than any one person.

body.heading: The brand's roots
body.text: Sweetgreen was founded in 2007 by three Georgetown University friends, Nicolas Jammet, Jonathan Neman and Nathaniel Ru, who opened a small salad shop in Washington, D.C. It grew into a fast-casual chain focused on salads, grain bowls and seasonal, locally sourced ingredients.

body.heading: Going public
body.text: Sweetgreen held its initial public offering in 2021, becoming a publicly traded company. Since then its ownership has been spread among public shareholders, while it continues to expand and invest in technology and new store formats.
